offerings.name: Google Search API
offerings.pricing: Starter $50 for 50k credits ($1.00/1k); Standard $375 for 500k credits ($0.75/1k); Scale $1250 for 2.5M credits ($0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 for 12.5M credits ($0.30/1k)
offerings.price_basis: Starter top-up (50k credits; lowest published entry tier)
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries (no credit card required)
offerings.note: Credits valid for 6 months; real-time uncached results; rate limits 50-300 QPS by tier; customizable country/language; endpoints include Search, Images, News, Maps, Places, Videos, Shopping, Scholar, Patents, Autocomplete; credits deducted on successful responses.
